_comment: The miniapps SQL the toolbox runs (launch-source.js), shared with tests/integration/test_miniapp_launch_checker.py, which runs it against the real schema.
launch_sql: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, u.role, l.artifact_code, l.version_id, l.workspace_id, l.agent_view_id, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(l.created_at) AS created_at, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(l.expires_at) AS expires_at, a.allowed_actions FROM launch l JOIN `user` u ON u.id = l.user_id JOIN miniapp_activation a ON a.artifact_code = l.artifact_code AND a.agent_view_id = l.agent_view_id AND a.approved_version_id = l.version_id WHERE l.id = ? AND l.exchange_redeemed_at IS NOT NULL AND l.revoked_at IS NULL AND l.expires_at > NOW() AND u.is_active = 1
retention_pin_sql: SELECT approved_version_id AS version_id FROM miniapp_activation WHERE artifact_code = ?
